RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Weapon quality control
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Newly crafted or constructed weapons receive a colony-wide quality floor. Stacks 1–5 guarantee Poor, Normal, Good, Excellent and Masterwork. Higher native results and personal quality steps remain intact. Only actual new products with quality; no repair, reinstall, trade, reward or historical-item processing.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Weapon craftsmanship
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: When this pawn finishes new weapons, add one quality level per stack after the colony floor. All eligible personal steps stack; final quality is capped at Legendary.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Master weaponsmith
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: When this pawn finishes new weapons using a work skill of at least 16, add one quality level per stack after the colony floor. Check the actual finishing worker and native skill snapshot; final quality is capped at Legendary.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Exceptional weapons
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: When this pawn finishes new weapons with a native quality of at least Excellent, add one quality level per stack. The colony floor and other quality cards cannot satisfy this native-quality condition; final quality is capped at Legendary.
